configure.title: Thatki rikuchiq
configure.description: Thatkikunata puriyta señalaq sutikunap huch'uy siq'in hina rikuchiy. Kay churakuypiqa thatkikunap ukhunqa manam rikuchikunchu.

configure.title: Kunan thatki
configure.description: Ñawinchaq kachkan thatki, 1 manta yupasqa. Ñawpaq thatkikunaqa tukusqa hina rikhurin. Thatki rikuchiqmi llamk'achin.
